evidence: Modifies FinalizePSBT in src/psbt.cpp exposed by the finalizepsbt RPC; wallet category guidance explicitly notes that PSBT changes without wallet code belong to rpc.
rationale: Fixes a bug where finalizepsbt returns complete: true and an invalid raw transaction hex when input witness or scriptSig scripts are invalid. In RPC, correctness of returned data is high priority, and returning a transaction that fails mempool verification while claiming completion directly violates expected RPC contract behavior.
